spawn.doc: delegate_task: spawn a subagent. NOTE: Hermes delegate_task has NO per-spawn model/effort args (verified in tools/delegate_tool.py) — children inherit the parent model. To give workers a different model, pin delegation.provider / delegation.model globally in config.yaml before the run, or start the coordinator session with that model.
spawn.model_flag: (not per-spawn: children inherit parent model, or set delegation.model in config.yaml)
